battle.name: 蒙哥攻宋之戰
battle.theater: 川南會州與金沙江前線
battle.brief: 蒙哥攻宋之戰起於1253年。忽必烈自忒剌分三路南下，以革囊木筏渡金沙江，十二月入大理；東路抄合、也只烈經茂州抵會州，攻拔川南要點，與雲南迂迴策應。蒙古攻城以配重投石車作長距火力，配楯車雲梯逼近宋軍山城。戰役延至1259年，蒙哥汗卒於釣魚城。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 蒙哥攻宋之戰的交戰方是蒙古帝國與南宋。蒙古方面由大汗蒙哥總節制，兵分多路而以工程進度為勝負所在：忽必烈領中路，1253年九月自忒剌分兵三路南下，十一月以革囊、木筏分批渡過金沙江，十二月十五日入大理城；兀良合台領西路，循晏當路穿吐蕃境入雲南，與中東兩路會於龍首關；宗王抄合、也只烈領東路，經茂州抵會川，作為牽制宋蜀的偏師。此外有帖哥火魯赤、帶答兒自利州、興元沿嘉陵江、渠江南下，紐璘經略東川，劉黑馬、夾谷龍古帶取西川，塔察兒、帖里垓經略荊州與兩淮。蒙古軍以十進制千戶編制，骨幹是草原騎兵，攻城所需漢地匠人、木匠、砲手另編專隊，並大量徵發漢地步卒與民夫。蒙古缺水軍，遂取大迂回，先取雲南與川南，再圖荊襄。南宋方面由理宗在趙與曄、謝方叔主持下分區防守：四川以余玠經營的山城防禦為骨幹，以釣魚城為支柱；荊湖沿孟珙生前所立的三層防禦，固江陵、樊城、鄂州；江淮各重鎮加築城寨，並以水步混編的游擊軍屯長江中應援。
countriesEn: The belligerents in the Möngke campaign against Song were the Mongol Empire and the Southern Song. On the Mongol side the Great Khan Möngke held supreme command, and the war was decided as much by engineering progress as by cavalry action. Kublai led the central column: in September 1253 he split his force three ways at Terchi, crossed the Jinsha River in batches on inflated leather bags and timber rafts in November, and entered the city of Dali on the fifteenth of December. Urankhadai led the western column along the Yandang road through Tibetan territory into Yunnan, joining the central and eastern columns at Longshou Pass; the princes Qaqa and Yichilie led the eastern column through Maozhou to Huichuan as a force pinning the Song defences in Sichuan. In addition, Tog'ogharachi and Badai'er came down from Lizhou and Xingyuan along the Jialing and Qu rivers, Nürin handled eastern Sichuan, Liu Heima and Jiyagu Gude led the western Sichuan army, and Tača'er and Teregai operated against Jingzhou and the two Huai regions. The Mongol host was organised on the decimal system of thousandmen, its backbone being steppe cavalry, while the engineers, carpenters and artillery crews drawn from Han China formed separate specialist units, and Han foot soldiers and corvée labour were levied in great numbers. Lacking a navy, the Mongols chose the great strategic roundabout, taking Yunnan and southern Sichuan first and only then reaching for Jing and Xiang. On the Song side Emperor Lizong governed with Zhao Yuyi and Xie Fangshu managing the court; in Sichuan Yu Jie's hill-fort system formed the backbone, with Diaoyu Castle as its pillar; in Jinghu the three-tiered defences laid out by Meng Gong and later Zhao Kui held Jiangling, Fancheng and Ezhou; and in the Jiang-Huai region the key towns were ringed with new fortresses while mixed water and land raiding units were stationed along the middle Yangtze to answer any crossing.
people: 蒙哥汗（1209至1259）是大軍與所有攻城序列的總指揮，1251年平定海迷失后與失烈門之亂後即籌備攻宋，1253年以迂迴兩翼為既定方針，1258年二月親率大軍南下，至1259年七月在釣魚城軍中病故，一說身中飛石。忽必烈（1215至1294）本年統中路征雲南，既取大理為側翼基地，又於1254年後接掌荊襄方向攻勢，1259年九月在鄂州前線得蒙哥死訊仍督軍猛攻。兀良合台為雲南右翼主將，沿大江南岸水陸並進，攻至重慶以北合州與各路會師，後轉圍潭州。汪德臣被擢為征蜀前鋒將，率軍越白龍江，攻苦竹隘、長寧山鵝頂堡、大獲城，屢克宋軍城隘。抄合、也只烈統東路在川南牽制宋軍，紐璘經略東川並架橋斷宋援，劉黑馬、夾谷龍古帶取成都，楊大淵降後引蒙軍入蜀。南宋方面，趙與曄、謝方叔主朝廷樞機，余玠建山城防禦，趙葵、孟宗政、劉整等主持荊襄防線，賈似道其時尚在仕途，後於1259年鄂州之役主和。攻城決策落到工匠與砲手手中，是本役一大特點。
peopleEn: Möngke Khan (1209-1259) was the overall commander of the host and of every siege sequence; after suppressing the revolt of the regentess Öghet Qaimish and of Shiregen, the son of Ögedei, in 1251 he began preparing the Song offensive, fixed the two-wing roundabout as his policy in 1253, and in February 1258 marched south with the main army himself, dying of illness in the field before Diaoyu Castle in the seventh month of 1259, according to one account crushed by a stray stone. Kublai (1215-1294) commanded the central column into Yunnan that year, both taking Dali as a flank base and later taking charge of the Jing-Xiang front; on the first day of the ninth month of 1259 he learned of Möngke's death at Ezhou and still pressed the attack. Urankhadai was the commander of the southern right wing, moving along the southern bank of the great river by land and water, joining the other columns near Hezhou before he turned to besiege Tanzhou. Wang Decheng was appointed vanguard commander of the Sichuan expedition, led the army across the Bailong River and took Kǔzhú Pass, E'ding Fort at Changningshan and the great city of Dahu, breaking Song strongholds one after another. Qaqa and Yichilie pinned the Song in southern Sichuan from the east, Nürin handled eastern Sichuan and bridged the Fu River to cut Song reinforcements, Liu Heima and Jiyagu Gude took Chengdu, and the defector Yang Dayuan guided the Mongols into the Sichuan interior. On the Song side Zhao Yuyi and Xie Fangshu handled state affairs, Yu Jie built the hill-fort system, Zhao Kui, Meng Zongzheng and Liu Zheng directed the Jing-Xiang line, and Jia Sidao, then still rising in office, would negotiate the settlement of 1259. What decided the sieges was in the end the judgment of the engineers and of the artillery crews, a special feature of this campaign.
kits: 本卡兵器是配重投石車，即中國史籍所稱的回回砲：以長槓為臂，臂尾懸配重，臂首套繩索兜住石彈，靠墜落的配重把石頭甩過城頭。這種砲與中國原有的桿砲、獨臂砲不同，是西亞與伊斯蘭世界的匠人隨蒙古西征帶入的技術，蒙古在1236年攻金朝蔡州時已用之破城，1253年攻宋各路已把它列為常設攻城器械。配重砲射程可達數百步，擊中城樓時樓閣應聲崩碎，遠超弓弩與投石手，適於轟壓宋軍山城與城內密集建築，掩護楯車與雲梯逼近；但它笨重、轉移緩慢，發動機需百餘人同時拉曳，必須依賴事先築好的砲位，發射後還要重新校準，因此蒙古軍在鄂州、潭州一類大城之下往往圍城數月而不急於強攻。同一攻城序列裡還有楯車、雲梯、壕橋與衝車，以及火藥輔助手段：蒙古有毒煙砲，宋軍則用弓弩、擂石、滾木、拒馬與火藥箭。糧秣方面，蒙古於沔州、利州築城屯田，川南諸役靠牛羊與沿途屯墾，川江往來則靠合木為筏的水路運輸。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the counterweight trebuchet, called in Chinese sources the huihui pao: a long beam is mounted as an arm, a weight hangs from the short end, and a sling at the far end carries the stone, which is thrown over the wall by the fall of the weight. It differs from the Chinese beam engines and single-arm catapults; it is a design brought into the east by Muslim engineers from the West Asian and Islamic world, and the Mongols had already used it to breach Caizhou in 1236 against the Jin. By 1253 the counterweight machine stood among the regular siege equipment of every Mongol column sent against Song. Its range ran to several hundred paces, and when a stone struck a tower the structure came apart, far beyond anything bow or hand weapon could reach; it was exactly the right instrument for battering Song hill-forts and the dense buildings inside them while screening the shielded carts and the ladders that moved up to the wall. Its weakness was weight and immobility: the throwing engine needed well over a hundred men to haul, it was slow to shift, it had to be set up on a prepared emplacement, and it needed re-aiming after every shot. That is why the Mongols would surround a great city such as Ezhou or Tanzhou for months rather than attempt a quick storm. The same siege train included covered carts, ladders, causeway planks and battering rams, alongside fire as an auxiliary means: the Mongols had smoke bombs, and the Song replied with crossbows, dropped stones, rolling logs, spiked fences and fire-arrow shafts. Supplies came from the garrisons and fields the Mongols planted at Mianzhou and Lizhou, from the herds that followed the column, and from the timber rafts that carried men and stores along the rivers of western Sichuan.
tactics: 蒙古在1253年定下的戰術骨架，是先取雲南再圖荊襄的大迂回，並在每一條戰線上以圍城打援取代強攻。忽必烈中路自滿陀城渡大渡河，取古清溪道走二千里山谷，抵金沙江後以充氣革囊與木筏分批渡江，殲大理主力於龍首關，再以大理降軍配合夾攻；東路自茂州南下會川，與西路形成夾擊，使宋的四川防線不能專力對付一路。攻成都、江陵、鄂州這類堅城時，蒙古不急於總攻，而以配重投石車反覆轟擊城頭、壕邊與援軍集結地，逼迫宋將出城反擊或分兵援城，然後在野戰中吃掉援軍；釣魚城一役即是把宋軍主力長期釘在山城、斷其糧道、以待其疲的典型。糧道是蒙軍的弱點，故紐璘在涪州西蔺架橋以阻宋軍東援，兀良合台沿大江南岸水陸並進正是為維持滇黔之間的補給線。蒙古同時在沔州、利州、興元一線築城屯田，把進攻變成長期駐紮，把戰爭拉成消耗戰。
tacticsEn: The tactical shape of the war was settled in 1253: take Yunnan first, then strike Jing and Xiang in a great roundabout, and at every front replace the assault with a blockade that hunted the relieving army. Kublai's central column crossed the Dadu at Mantuo, took the old Qingxi road through two thousand li of gorges, and at the Jinsha River ferried itself over in batches on inflated skin bags and timber rafts, annihilating the main Dali force at Longshou Pass before pressing on with the surrendered Dali troops. The eastern column came down from Maozhou to Huichuan, closing on the other flank so that the Song could never concentrate its Sichuan forces against one approach. Before the great cities of Chengdu, Jiangling and Ezhou the Mongols did not press home; they hammered the walls, the ditch and the ground where Song relief armies gathered with the counterweight engines, forcing the Song commanders either to sally out or to split their strength, and then took the relief army in the open field. The siege of Diaoyu, which lasted five months without success, is the extreme case of pinning a Song army in its mountains, cutting its supply and waiting for it to tire. Supply was the Mongols' weak point, which is why Nürin bridged the river at Xilin to block Song reinforcements from the east, and why Urankhadai moved along the southern bank by land and water at once, keeping the route between Yunnan and Guizhou open. The building of garrison towns and fields at Mianzhou, Lizhou and Xingyuan turned the offensive into a long stay, and the war into a war of attrition.
data: 可考的數字多來自元史與續資治通鑑。1253年忽必烈征雲南，兵分三路，統兵以萬計，實際投入作戰的兵馬在數萬之眾；蒙哥自隴州經大散關南進時親率四萬兵，1257年塔察兒以十萬騎攻襄陽、樊城，圍樊城七日不克而還，1259年忽必烈在鄂州之役破宋軍十萬人的阻截。時間上，蒙哥攻釣魚城歷五個月未克，1259年九月忽必烈圍鄂州後攻兩月未下，十一月初二得察必密信才議北還。器械方面，配重投石車發動機須百餘人同時拉曳，所擲石彈常在百斤上下，擊中城樓可令樓閣粉碎；宋人史籍記其攻城之威，所中樓閣盡為粉碎。元史又記蒙古用砲石攻潭州，屢發屢中，說明砲兵在整個戰役序列中是可以連續運作的力量，而非一次性的攻城花招。1259年七月蒙哥汗卒於軍中，蒙古全線攻勢為之中止，其後宋方得數十年喘息。
dataEn: The figures that can be relied on come mainly from the History of Yuan and the Xu Zizhi Tongjian. In 1253 Kublai's expedition into Yunnan was divided into three columns and fielded tens of thousands of men, with a few tens of thousands actually engaged in the fighting; when Möngke marched south from Longzhou by way of Dasan Pass in 1258 he led forty thousand troops, in 1257 Tača'er attacked Xiangyang and Fancheng with a hundred thousand riders and gave up after seven days before Fancheng, and in 1259 Kublai at Ezhou broke through a Song blocking force said to number a hundred thousand men. In time, the siege of Diaoyu lasted five months without success, the investment of Ezhou begun in the ninth month of 1259 was still undecided two months later, and only the letter from Chabi on the second day of the eleventh month brought the decision to march north. As for the machines, the counterweight engine needed more than a hundred men hauling at once, and the stones it threw commonly weighed on the order of a hundred catties; a tower struck by one of them came down shattered, and Chinese records of these engines say that what they hit was smashed utterly. The History of Yuan records the Mongols at Tanzhou throwing stone with their artillery and hitting again and again, which shows the gun crews could operate continuously throughout the campaign rather than merely stage a single showpiece attack. Möngke Khan died in the field in the seventh month of 1259 and the whole Mongol offensive stopped there, after which the Song gained some decades of respite.
cause: 蒙古自窩闊台、貴由兩朝攻宋以來，野戰雖勝而攻坚屢挫，長江與江淮的堅城擋住正面推進，遂有取道西南迂迴之議。1251年蒙哥繼大汗位，平定海迷失后及失烈門之亂，穩固汗位後於1252年七月命忽必烈征大理國，把雲貴高原變成北方騎兵難以直達卻能俯瞰南方江漢的側翼；1253年忽必烈滅大理，蒙古遂於1256年完成對宋的戰略包圍，兵分右翼，由兀良合台自雲南、帖哥火魯赤與帶答兒自利州興元，夾攻四川，左翼由塔察兒、帖里垓攻荊州兩淮，事端以宋拘留蒙古使者為由發動。南宋方面，蒙古屯田於沔州、利州，並在唐州、鄧州、嵩州、汝州、蔡州、息州、亳州、潁州諸處駐兵，實質是把邊境變成長期據點，壓縮宋的屯田與榷場，先奪補給再決戰。技術條件同樣關鍵：1236年蔡州之戰帶回的回回砲在此後二十年成為蒙古攻城的主武器，缺了它，迂迴再遠也只是拉長補給線。
causeEn: Since the campaigns of Ögedei and Güyük against Song, the Mongols had won their open-field battles but had been checked again and again before fortresses, and the Yangtze with its fortified cities in the river country blocked any frontal advance; hence the proposal to reach Song from the southwest. In 1251 Möngke succeeded to the khanship, put down the regentess and Shiregen, and, having consolidated his position, in July 1252 ordered Kublai to conquer Dali so that the Yunnan-Guizhou plateau might become a flank from which northern cavalry, unable to reach it directly, could look down on the rivers of the south. Kublai destroyed Dali in 1253, and in 1256 the Mongols judged their encirclement of Song complete, splitting the host into a right wing under Urankhadai from Yunnan and Tog'ogharachi and Badai'er from Lizhou and Xingyuan, and a left wing under Tača'er and Teregai against Jingzhou and the Huai region; the hostilities were opened on the pretext that Song had detained Mongol envoys. On the Song side, the establishment of Mongol garrisons and fields at Mianzhou and Lizhou, and of troops at Tangzhou, Dengzhou, Songzhou, Ruzhou, Caizhou, Xizhou, Bozhou and Yingzhou, was in substance the conversion of the frontier into permanent bases, squeezing the Song farms and markets before any decision was fought. The technical conditions mattered just as much: the counterweight engine that had proved itself at Caizhou in 1236 was by then the Mongols' chief weapon of siege, and without it even the widest roundabout would only have lengthened the supply line.
impact: 此役的直接後果是宋蒙戰爭的形態被永久改變：蒙古放棄正面叩長江，改由雲南、荊襄兩側包抄，宋的江淮與四川防線自此被拉成首尾不能相顧的長鏈，釣魚城、襄陽、鄂州一線成為此後十五年雙方反覆爭奪的地帶。1259年七月蒙哥汗死於釣魚城軍中，忽必烈在鄂州前線聞訊仍攻不退，旋以母喪與汗位之爭北歸，1260年忽必烈與阿里不哥爭立汗位，蒙古內戰三年，攻宋全面停頓，直到1268年再啟襄樊之役，1276年臨安出降，1279年崖山之役宋亡。技術層面的遺產更為長久：配重砲與其匠人留在中國，元代軍中設砲手軍戶與專門的軍器機構，後來元軍攻襄陽時一砲擊中譙樓、聲如雷霆、守將皆驚的記載，說明這件兵器在漢地已被完全消化；同一時期蒙古西征又把配重砲與築城技術帶往中亞與東歐，令歐洲城堡防線在十四世紀之後加速改變。對南宋而言，此役是它在江淮與四川最盛的一次機會，也是它自此失去主動的轉折。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of this campaign was a permanent change in the shape of the Song-Mongol war: the Mongols gave up frontal assaults on the Yangtze and took the south from Yunnan and Jing-Xiang instead, so that the Song's Jiang-Huai and Sichuan lines were drawn out into a long chain whose ends could never support each other, and Diaoyu, Xiangyang and Ezhou became the ground on which both sides fought over and over for the next fifteen years. When Möngke died before Diaoyu in July 1259, Kublai at Ezhou did not retreat at once but was soon recalled by his mother's death and the struggle over the khanship; in 1260 Kublai and Ariq Böke contested the throne, and the Mongol civil war of three years brought the Song offensive to a complete halt until the Xiang-Fan campaign was reopened in 1268, followed by the fall of Lin'an in 1276 and the end of Song at Yamen in 1279. The legacy in technique was longer-lived still: the counterweight engine and the craftsmen who served it stayed in China, the Yuan army kept gun-crew households and specialist armament offices of its own, and the later record of a single shot striking the watchtower at Xiangyang with a sound like thunder, which left the defenders of the city shaken, shows how completely the weapon was absorbed in Chinese hands. In the same decades the Mongol expeditions carried the counterweight engine and their fortification methods back to Central Asia and Eastern Europe, and European castle defences began to change quickly after the fourteenth century. For the Southern Song, this campaign was the last great chance it was given on the Jiang-Huai and in Sichuan, and at the same time the turning point after which it never again held the initiative.
result: 到1253年這個開局，蒙古的目標尚是完成迂迴而非決戰：忽必烈十一月渡金沙江、十二月入大理，東路抄合、也只烈抵會州會理，雲南與川南同時在手，側後包圍的形勢於1256年成形；其後帖哥火魯赤與帶答兒沿嘉陵江、渠江南下，兀良合台在馬湖江破宋軍得船二百艘改道東進，三路大軍於合州會師，四川北部的州縣接連失守，1258年成都陷落。1259年蒙哥親征釣魚城，歷五個月未克，軍中疫病流行，孟秋七月大汗卒於軍中，一說身中飛石，攻蜀之師北撤，鄂州之圍亦解，潭州之圍隨之罷，賈似道以割江為界、每歲銀絹二十萬兩匹為條件求和，蒙哥攻宋至此休戰。配重投石車在此役中確立了它在蒙古軍攻城體系裡的位置：它不是破城的唯一鑰匙，釣魚城的山城地形讓任何攻城砲都無能為力，它卻是把遠程火力、封鎖城頭與消耗守軍綁在一起的關鍵一環。此後元軍在襄樊、在平江、乃至在海上遠征中仍沿用同一套砲與船的組合。
resultEn: At the opening of 1253 the Mongols' object was still to complete the roundabout rather than to force a decision. Kublai crossed the Jinsha River in November and entered Dali in December, the eastern column under Qaqa and Yichilie reached Huichuan and Huili, and with Yunnan and southern Sichuan in hand the shape of the flank encirclement was completed in 1256. Thereafter Tog'ogharachi and Badai'er came down the Jialing and Qu rivers, Urankhadai broke the Song army at the Malu River, took two hundred boats and turned east, the three columns met near Hezhou, and the prefectures of northern Sichuan fell one after another, Chengdu itself being lost in 1258. In 1259 Möngke came in person against Diaoyu, failed in five months, saw disease run through his army, and died in the field in the seventh month, by one account killed by a flying stone; the army that had come to take Sichuan withdrew north, the siege of Ezhou was lifted, that of Tanzhou ended with it, and Jia Sidao made his peace on the terms of a river boundary and two hundred thousand taels and bolts of silver and silk a year, bringing the Möngke offensive against Song to a close. The counterweight trebuchet had by then fixed its place in the Mongol system of siege: it was not the one key to the city, since the mountain terrain of Diaoyu left any artillery powerless, but it was the element that bound long-range fire, the sealing of the walls and the exhaustion of the garrison into a single instrument. The Yuan army would go on using the same combination of artillery and boats against Xiang-Fan, against Pingjiang, and even in the sea-borne expeditions.
